title: A Quinta Cadeira
summary: Tuesday 2027-02-02. Aphromoo asks to stop being formally the support mentor and remain only Head Coach of Kairos Main. Adrian, Thinkcard, Hai and Sable agree; after a video call, Xpecial (Alex Chu) accepts the role of support mentor for the three League teams, with in-person activities to start in the following days after administrative steps. The mentor structure becomes five dedicated mentors.
keyEvents: 7:42 — Aphromoo realises he gave too much attention to Taric execution with Moss and too little to collective decisions after the Dignitas series.
8:36 — Aphromoo, with Thinkcard, tells Adrian he wants to remain Head Coach of Main but give up the formal support-mentor role; he proposes Xpecial.
9:54 — Video call with Xpecial: mentor of the three support starters; Head Coaches keep draft authority; he asks to watch bad games and talk to the academy coaches first.
11:27–12:18 — Hai and Sable agree; both ask that Lucas and Ryan not receive conflicting instructions or be judged by single decisions.
13:39 — Aphromoo tells Moss; Moss fears he is not improving and is told the decision is not about performance.

15:08–16:24 — Xpecial reviews the Main loss to Dignitas, Blue loss to Blue Otter and White win over Mississippi; proposes a weekly joint session of the three supports; accepts the role without authority over the academy coaches; no financial or contract terms are disclosed.
17:51 — The three supports meet Xpecial by video; 22:04 final organisation chart: Top Darshan, Jungle Xmithie, Mid Goldenglue, ADC WildTurtle, Support Xpecial.
consequences: Aphromoo remains exclusively Head Coach of Main; Thinkcard keeps the strategic work; Hai and Sable keep command of Blue and White.
Xpecial becomes the fifth dedicated position mentor.
canonIntroduced: Xpecial (Alex Chu) accepts the role of support mentor for the three Kairos League teams on 2027-02-02.
Aphromoo gives up the formal support-mentor function.
canonChanged: The author directive of 2026-11-13 that named Xpecial support mentor is now narrated in story: the first conversation and acceptance are on 2027-02-02.
continuityNotes: The start of Xpecial's in-person activities and all contract terms are not stated.
Seven LCS opponents are listed: Cloud9, FlyQuest, Team Liquid, Dignitas, LYON, Sentinels, Shopify Rebellion.
realWorldReferences: Xpecial is a real-world former professional support; his in-story role is fictional-canon.
confirmedFacts: Xpecial accepts the support mentor role on 2027-02-02; no contract details are disclosed.
Mentors: Top Darshan, Jungle Xmithie, Mid Goldenglue, ADC WildTurtle, Support Xpecial.
Aphromoo remains Head Coach of Kairos Main; Hai commands Blue; Sable commands White; Thinkcard remains responsible for strategic work.
